name: PHIL 5330
title: Seminar on Theory of Knowledge
description: Problems in the foundations and nature of knowledge. A critical study of recent treatments of the problem of mind. Issues such as the mind-body problem, our knowledge of the existence of other minds, the existence of private languages, will be dealt with in detail. May be repeated for a total of 12 credits.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in Philosophy, others with consent.
